weaknesses.title: EXIT 0 does not clear sticky last_err; -s still fails the process
weaknesses.detail: FAIL then EXIT 0 yields plate exit_code=0 halted=true but last_err remains the FAIL text. With run -s, process rc=1 and ok=false despite intentional clean EXIT. Agents cannot treat EXIT 0 as unconditional success under strict mode without CLEAR_ERR first.
weaknesses.repro:
printf 'HOLD_FLASH 1
FAIL "soft"
EXIT 0 "claim"
' | ./out/cubalc run - -q -s → rc=1 ok=false exit_code=0 last_err=FAIL…

weaknesses.title: SETDIGIT then IMPULSE/FLOW/DECIDE can yield a different digit
weaknesses.detail: Observed SETDIGIT peer0 → 7 then IMPULSE+FLOW+DECIDE brain → 8. Config workers that inject a host digit cannot naively DECIDE afterward and expect the same value. No in-lang doc form warns; must treat SETDIGIT as the result or avoid post-seed FLOW.
weaknesses.repro: SETDIGIT peer0 7; IMPULSE peer0; FLOW 2; DECIDE brain — dig may not be 7

weaknesses.title: No SYS NUM <var>; must CAT into LAST before parse
weaknesses.detail: SYS NUM always parses LAST. After SYS EQS job_arg "", LAST is the compare result (0/1), so SYS NUM silently digests the boolean. Workaround: SYS CAT job_arg "" then SYS NUM. Easy footgun in config-driven ARG paths.
weaknesses.repro: LET a="7"; SYS EQS a ""; SYS NUM → parses EQS residue not "7"

weaknesses.title: No human-plane job dispatch (CASE/switch missing from forms)
weaknesses.detail: Config workers need multi-mode branches. LANGUAGE.md mentions CASE/WHEN but cubalc forms CASE and search case return n=0. Real programs become long SYS EQS ladders with nested IF — ugly for agents to emit and maintain.
weaknesses.repro: ./out/cubalc forms CASE → n=0; ./out/cubalc search case → n=0

weaknesses.title: WRITE fatal still err_line=0; plate exit_code stays 0
weaknesses.detail: Missing CUBALC_STATE parent: err=write: No such file…, process rc=1, but exit_code field remains 0 and err_src empty. CI parsers that only read exit_code miss the failure mode vs EXIT n.

weaknesses.title: cubalc init scaffold DECIDE kernel (host) not braincube
weaknesses.detail: Generated starter places host+body and DECIDE kernel. Works (ok plate) but is not the peer_decide recipe; agents extending init without reading matrix law get weak/odd digits. Scaffold could INCLUDE peer_decide pattern or place braincube.

workarounds: CLEAR_ERR immediately before EXIT 0 when any soft FAIL/EXPECT/INCLUDE OR ran
For host-injected digits: SETDIGIT then use LAST_N/dig directly; do not re-DECIDE after FLOW
SYS CAT var "" before SYS NUM to parse a string variable
Dispatch jobs with SYS EQS ladders until CASE is catalogued
Prefer plate ok + process rc over exit_code alone when WRITE may fatal
language_gaps: EXIT 0 should optionally clear sticky last_err or document -s interaction
SYS NUM name | SYS INT name for variable parse
Human-plane CASE/WHEN or JOB dispatch form in forms catalog
err_line/err_src on SYS WRITE fatals; non-zero exit_code on I/O fatal
SETDIGIT stickiness vs DECIDE semantics documented in cookbook
init template closer to agent real paths (braincube / STATUS / optional EXIT)
